orders.text:
WPMS No. 244 of 2018
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. S.R. Joshi, Standing Counsel, 
present for the State/respondent nos.1 to 
4. 
 In spite of repeated opportunities, 
counter affidavit has not been filed on 
behalf of the respondents. 
 Purely, in the interest of justice, 
four days’ further time is granted to the 
respondents to file counter affidavit, 
provided they deposit a cost of Rs.2,500/- 
(Rupees Two Thousand Five Hundred 
Only) in the Registry. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
gives his consent and agrees that the cost 
so deposited by the respondents may be 
transferred to the Uttarakhand High Court 
Lawyers Welfare Fund. Let the cost so 
deposited by the respondents be 
transferred to the Uttarakhand High Court 
Lawyers Welfare Fund. 
 List this matter on 27.06.2018 in 
the daily cause list. 
 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 21.06.2018 
Nitesh/

CLMA No. 6865 of 2020 (Intervention Application)
In 
WPMS No. 244 of 2018
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
The case is taken up through video 
conferencing.
There is no representation for the 
parties, except Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, 
Additional C.S.C. for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
After considering the averments 
made in the intervention application, it is 
provided that the intervener shall be 
heard at the time of final hearing. 
Intervention application is, 
accordingly, disposed of. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) Arpan 28.10.2020
